title: RAFT: Reward rAnked FineTuning for Generative Foundation Model Alignment
authors_zh: Junxian He、Chunting Zhou、Xuezhe Ma、Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick、Graham Neubig
paper_type_zh: 奖励排序驱动的数据选择与生成模型对齐研究
best_for_zh: 适合研究奖励模型如何作为训练样本选择器的读者。
one_line: RAFT samples candidates, selects the reward-best response, and fine-tunes the policy on it.
RAFT 从多个策略候选中保留奖励最高的回答，并用该回答迭代监督微调模型。
why: It turns a reward model into a data-selection mechanism rather than an online RL objective.
inclusion_reason: Uses a reward model to select policy-generated records for the next supervised fine-tuning update.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Online reward optimization is costly and can be unstable. Yet a reward model can still identify a better response among policy samples.

RAFT asks how that ranking can create the next supervised training set without running a full online RL update.

在线奖励优化成本高，也可能不稳定。不过，奖励模型仍能从策略样本中识别较好的回答。

RAFT 要问的是，如何利用这种排序构造下一轮监督训练集，而不执行完整的在线强化学习更新。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
For each prompt, the policy proposes several answers and a reward model ranks them. Only the best-ranked answer becomes a target for fine-tuning.

The reward therefore governs record selection, while SFT remains the training consumer.

对于每个提示，策略提出多个回答，奖励模型对它们排序。只有排名最高的回答成为微调目标。

奖励因此控制记录选择，而监督微调仍是训练使用方。

title: Method
方法
html:
RAFT alternates sampling, reward scoring, top-response selection, and fine-tuning. The next policy then generates a new candidate pool.

The selection budget determines how many alternatives a reward model may inspect before one record is retained.

RAFT 交替进行采样、奖励评分、最佳回答选择和微调。下一版策略随后生成新的候选池。

选择预算决定奖励模型在保留一条记录前可以检查多少替代项。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that reward-ranked fine-tuning can improve alignment tasks under its evaluated settings. It supports selection as a viable alternative to directly optimizing reward online.

The result depends on the reward model finding useful distinctions among the sampled candidates.

论文报告，在所评估设定下，奖励排序微调能够改善对齐任务。它支持将选择视为直接在线优化奖励的可行替代方案。

结果依赖奖励模型能在采样候选间发现有用差异。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
RAFT makes best-of-n selection an explicit training-data operation. The reward model chooses a record instead of supplying a gradient to the policy.

This separates feedback evaluation from the SFT update while keeping both in an iterative loop.

RAFT 使 best-of-n 选择成为显式训练数据操作。奖励模型选择记录，而不是向策略提供梯度。

这将反馈评估与监督微调更新分开，同时仍把二者保留在迭代循环中。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Reward errors and narrow candidate pools are amplified by repeated top-one selection. The procedure can also reduce diversity and reward superficial response traits.
奖励错误和狭窄候选池会被反复的 top-one 选择放大。该过程也可能降低多样性，并奖励表面的回答特征。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use RAFT when candidate generation is cheap and a reward model is available, but online RL is undesirable. Log candidates, scores, and selection decisions for audit.
当候选生成便宜、已有奖励模型但不希望采用在线强化学习时，可使用 RAFT。应记录候选、分数和选择决定以便审计。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Inspect reward calibration, candidate count, sampling diversity, and whether selected examples are refreshed after each update. These decide the quality of the retained dataset.
应检查奖励校准、候选数量、采样多样性，以及每次更新后是否刷新所选样本。这些决定保留数据集的质量。
